_about: Sea step 10 super bosses (core/sea/boss_rules.gd, game/sea_boss.gd, game/boss_strikes.gd; design diary/DESIGN_BOSSES.md, LOCKED: 3 phases + enrage, the arena changes per phase, health and adds scale to 1-6 players, an OFFERING per attempt (a wipe uses it), DREAD per death until a port rest, downed players are revived by teammates). A boss lives in its own arena dungeon (data/sea/dungeons.json, `arena`) reached through the sealed door `door` of `temple` once someone lays the offering there. base_hp at 1 player x (1 + hp_per_extra x extra players) x the region's growth (core/sea/threat_rules.gd). phases: until = health share where the next phase begins; armour = share of a hit on the body that gets through; tide = the arena's tide step (index into the arena fight's tide levels, -1 = dry; rise = steps climbed one by one every rise_s); attacks by id (attacks{}); adds = enemies (data/enemies.json) from the arena's add spots every adds_every s (+ per party size); shed = the shell is left behind (everything takes full damage, speed / damage mults). parts = hit boxes on the model's nodes: weak (share x a hit, whatever the armour), breakable (own hp; breaking all of a phase's opens the shell for crack_s, then they grow back). attacks: shape arc (reach m, deg wide in front), ring (a wave along the floor from the boss: speed m/s, width m, max_r m; jump_h m off your ground clears it), charge (run speed m/s for length m, width m), under (burrows and comes up under a player: radius m), lob (count balls at players, flight s, radius m), leap (jumps onto a player: flight s, radius m); windup s = the warning, recover s, gap s before the next, hits = repeats. stun: hooking the bell's clapper after the shell is shed stuns it for seconds, once every cooldown. ALL NAMES / NUMBERS MINE (placeholders).

lantern._about: The Lantern Queen's own arena rules (core/sea/lantern_rules.gd, game/sea_boss_lantern.gd). fog: the arena's fog density by phase (env of data/sea/dungeons.json while she fights); each lit brazier thins phase 1's by lit_thin. light_r: a lit brazier's circle; while she is in one she is EXPOSED (her body takes all of a hit, her gills are live). Braziers go out burn_s after they were lit (the dungeon thing's burn_s). lure: a player who keeps her lure bulb within view_deg of his view and within reach_m for hold_s is walked toward the pool at pull_mps (each player on his own machine) until he looks away or is shoved. clouds: a spore pod's landing leaves a cloud for cloud_s; standing in one blinds for blind_s.

lure.notice: The light... you walk toward it

lantern_queen.trophy_line: The Lantern Queen's lure, cut from its stalk. It still glows when the room goes quiet.
